description: ESLint code style enforcement with custom rules. Uses typescript-eslint, perfectionist (alphabetical sorting of imports, exports, interfaces, objects, enums, switch cases, union types), unused-imports plugin, and a custom no-default-export rule. Enforces named exports, catch variable naming (must be 'err'), eqeqeq, object-shorthand, prefer-const, and prefer-template.
spec:
1. Verify `bun run lint` passes with no errors.
2. Verify eslint.config.js enforces named exports (no-default-export rule).
3. Verify eslint.config.js enforces catch variable naming via no-restricted-syntax selector.
4. Verify perfectionist plugin sorts imports, exports, interfaces, objects alphabetically.
5. Verify unused-imports plugin removes unused imports and warns on unused vars.
6. Verify `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` is set to error.
title: ESLint Code Style Enforcement
